segments.text: Listen up. Your body is a car. V2 max equals size of engine. Your engine runs on oxygen. How much oxygen your engine uses at full throttle is your V2 max. Each extra point of your V2 max is linked to 45 days of more life. Want a bigger engine? Two ways. First, zone 2 cardio three to four times per week.

This builds more capillaries, the fuel lines that deliver more oxygen, and more mitochondria, the cylinders that use it to make energy. Second, high intensity interval training one to two times per week. Short bursts 80 to 90% of your maximum heart rate. This trains a heart to pump more blood per beat and the muscles to pull more oxygen from it.
Zone two builds the engine. Hit tunes for power. Don't wait for a check engine light. Start building now.
